Name: switch_sun_to_son
Title: Switch Baseline from SU(N) to SO(N) and Keep Comparable Metrics
Experiment: Modify experiment.py to replace SU(N) generation with SO(N) generation using QR factorization and a det=+1 correction. Preserve the output JSON schema (final_info.json with a 'means' dictionary of scalars) so results remain directly comparable to the existing SU(N) baseline. Compute analogous metrics for SO(N): determinant deviation from +1, orthogonality deviation (||U^T U - I||_max), and Frobenius norms to the identity for several generation scales. Update notes to briefly compare SO(N) vs SU(N).
